purpose: Public drug data sources for medication identity and label discovery. These sources do not constitute an interaction checker or prescribing guideline.

sources.title: RxNorm API
sources.content_rights: non_proprietary_RxNorm_content; RxClass includes SNOMED CT subject to separate terms
sources.attribution: This product uses publicly available data from the U.S. National Library of Medicine (NLM), National Institutes of Health, Department of Health and Human Services; NLM is not responsible for the product and does not endorse or recommend this or any other product.
limits: NLM API terms state 20 requests/second/IP and recommend 12–24 hour caching.
RxNav's Drug-Drug Interaction API was discontinued January 2, 2024.
Does not provide a complete drug-interaction screening service or patient-specific prescribing recommendation.

sources.title: openFDA Drug Product Labeling API
sources.attribution: Data provided by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (https://open.fda.gov)
limits: openFDA states data is generally CC0/public domain unless otherwise noted; some private-party material can carry third-party rights.
The labeling API can contain manufacturer-submitted labeling that FDA says may not be the label for currently distributed products or identical to the approved labeling.
The API documentation says not to rely on openFDA alone to make medical-care decisions.
Do not copy full label text into a curated knowledge base by default; display metadata and link to the authoritative source.

sources.title: DailyMed SPL Web Services
limits: API provides current Structured Product Labeling (SPL) data and version history.
Do not assume public access alone authorizes bulk redistribution of all label content; check the specific record and applicable rights notices.
Labeling supports reference review but does not replace patient-specific clinical assessment.

sources.title: CDC dental antibiotic prescribing and stewardship resources
sources.publisher: US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
limits: Scope depends on the specific patient population and clinical question described by the resource.
Check document version and any embedded third-party material before reuse.
Must be reviewed by a qualified dentist before a product evidence card is approved.

sources.title: ADA dental clinical practice guidelines and stewardship content
limits: Free online access is not by itself permission to copy or embed full text.
Check publisher/article-level license, current version, defined population, and supersession status before deriving product content.

sources.title: RxNav Drug-Drug Interaction API
limits: NLM states the RxNav drug-drug interaction features were discontinued on January 2, 2024.
